concepts.title: 指数函数与模型
concepts.summary: $a^x$要求$a>0,a\ne1$；底数大于1时递增，小于1时递减。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用关键点、平移、反射和渐近线作图；模型用已知数据求常数。

en.title: Exponential functions and models
en.summary: $a^x$ requires $a>0,a\ne1$; it increases for $a>1$ and decreases for $0<a<1$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Graph with key points, translations, reflections and asymptotes; use data to find model constants.

concepts.title: 对数、定义域与法则
concepts.summary: 对数真数必须为正；乘积、商与幂法则适用于满足定义域的表达式。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 先检查定义域，再展开、合并或改写指数形式。

en.title: Logarithms, domains and rules
en.summary: Logarithm arguments must be positive; product, quotient and power rules apply on their valid domains.

method.title: Method
method.body: Check domains before expanding, condensing or converting to exponential form.

concepts.title: 指数与对数方程、不等式
concepts.summary: 使用同底数单射性或取对数；指数替换变量必须为正。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 整理、求候选解、代回原式；底数小于1时不等号反向。

en.title: Exponential and logarithmic equations and inequalities
en.summary: Use equal-base injectivity or take logarithms; an exponential substitution is positive.

method.title: Method
method.body: Simplify, solve for candidates, and check the original equation; reverse inequalities for bases below 1.

concepts.title: 利息、增长衰减与逻辑斯蒂模型

method.title: 方法
method.body: 用模型代入求值；解时间时取对数，保留实际有效域和单位。

en.title: Interest, growth, decay and logistic models

method.title: Method
method.body: Substitute in the model; take logarithms to solve for time, retaining realistic domains and units.

concepts.title: 对数尺度
concepts.summary: pH、震级、分贝、音高与星等均用对数比较量值。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 由差值推比值；注意pH和星等的方向。

en.title: Logarithmic scales
en.summary: pH, magnitude, decibels, pitch and star magnitude compare quantities logarithmically.

method.title: Method
method.body: Convert differences to ratios, keeping the directions of pH and star magnitude.
